deviations.claim_in_article: It is now proven beyond doubt that suggested tip screens cause guilt tipping in every customer who sees one.
deviations.issue: F008 presents guilt tipping as the author’s proposed social-pressure mechanism, not as a proven causal effect applying to every person who sees a screen.
deviations.explanation: The claim generalizes the scope to every customer, turns the proposed mechanism into proven causation, and overstates certainty; these are scope, causality, and certainty deviations.
